use_when: multiple humans/agents/runtimes need durable shared tasks, permissions, approvals, audit, scheduling, knowledge, and runtime routing
avoid_when: solo/local work can be completed safely in an existing AI IDE

notes: Choose hosted or self-hosted deployment from the current upstream documentation.
Self-hosting currently involves Node/npm and PostgreSQL plus optional provider CLIs; do not introduce this infrastructure unless organizational governance is the actual requirement.
AgentRouter may be useful as part of AgentSpace's runtime normalization path; do not duplicate that routing layer inside AAOP.

credentials: workspace/provider credentials required by the chosen deployment only
permissions: external service delegation only as required

checks: verify one agent task through the selected runtime
verify an approval/permission boundary when governance is the reason for adoption
confirm persistent outputs/audit evidence meet the original requirement

steps: revoke daemon/provider credentials created only for the integration
follow upstream uninstall/decommission steps for self-hosted infrastructure

warnings: AgentSpace is a control plane/workspace, not a lightweight per-task dependency. Treat deployment as a Level 5 decision.
